summary: Implemented every stub in voluptuous/schema_builder.py (Schema compile/infer/extend, mapping, dict, object, sequence, tuple, list and set validators, scalar and sort helpers, message, validate decorator) and added the missing default_factory, raises, Self and _compile. With the upstream Invalid/MultipleInvalid API (path, msg, prepend, add) supplied at runtime, the full suite passes 148/148 and the schema_builder and tests.md doctests pass; the last official c0-test full-suite run showed 59 passed and 89 failed, all because error.py still lacks those properties (builder-owned file, not edited).
